articles.title: Fake Doctor Caught Prescribing Medicines at Bijnor Medical College Hospital, Flees After Suspicion
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A commotion broke out at the district hospital affiliated with the medical college in Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh, on Friday morning after pharmacy staff caught an alleged fake doctor prescribing medicines to serious patients by misusing the official seal of an assistant professor.

body.html:
A commotion broke out at the district hospital affiliated with the medical college in Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh, on Friday morning after pharmacy staff caught an alleged fake doctor prescribing medicines to serious patients by misusing the official seal of an assistant professor.

The incident occurred in OPD room number 25, where TB and chest disease patients are treated. According to hospital staff, an unknown masked person was found issuing prescriptions using the stamp of Assistant Professor Dr. Tushar Singh, a TB and chest specialist, who was not present at the hospital at the time.

Pharmacy staff became suspicious after noticing a large number of prescriptions bearing Dr. Tushar’s seal, with similar medicines being prescribed repeatedly, including to very young patients. Around 9.30 am, Chief Pharmacist Rajesh Ravi and other staff went to room number 25 to verify the matter and found that neither Dr. Tushar nor any junior resident was present.

An unidentified person was found examining patients and writing prescriptions. When questioned, he claimed to be Dr. Tushar’s assistant but denied being a doctor or a hospital employee. This led to a heated exchange, following which other doctors gathered at the spot.

A senior doctor contacted Dr. Tushar over the phone, who initially said the person might be his assistant and identified him as a BAMS doctor named Dinesh, stating that he would reach the hospital shortly. However, before further clarification, the alleged fake doctor took advantage of the situation and fled. A video related to the incident has also surfaced on social media, though it has not been officially verified.

Hospital staff expressed concern that room number 25 handles critical TB and chest disease cases, and incorrect prescriptions could prove fatal. They claimed such activity may have been going on for some time.

Clarifying the matter, Dr. Tushar Singh said that in his absence, patients are usually seen by a junior resident or intern. He stated that he did not recognise the individual in question and had assumed it was his assistant during the phone call.

Dr. B.R. Tyagi, Chief Medical Superintendent (CMS) of Bijnor District Hospital, said no formal complaint has been submitted so far. He added that a committee will be formed to investigate the incident and appropriate action will be taken as per rules.

articles.title: Indian Tourist Assaulted on Pattaya Walking Street Over Alleged Payment Dispute
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An Indian tourist was allegedly assaulted by a group of Thai transwomen on Pattaya’s Walking Street in the early hours of Saturday, December 27, reportedly following a dispute over payment for s*x services.

body.html:
An Indian tourist was allegedly assaulted by a group of Thai transwomen on Pattaya’s Walking Street in the early hours of Saturday, December 27, reportedly following a dispute over payment for s*x services.

According to rescue officials, the Sawang Borriboon Dhammastan Foundation received an alert around 5.30 am about a foreign national being attacked near the entrance of Walking Street. Rescue workers rushed to the spot and found the injured man, later identified as 52-year-old Indian national Raj Jasuja, with injuries to his face and the back of his head.

The victim was given first aid at the scene before being shifted to Pattamakun Hospital for further medical treatment.

A local witness, 19-year-old Phongphon, told rescue workers that he saw the Indian man arguing with a transgender s*x worker near the entrance of Walking Street. The argument reportedly escalated into a physical altercation, following which the transgender woman allegedly called several associates, who then joined in and assaulted the tourist.

According to the witness, the dispute stemmed from a disagreement over payment, with the claim that the Indian man did not pay the full amount agreed upon for the service.

Police later told the We Love Pattaya Facebook page that the injured tourist would be asked to file a formal complaint once he recovers. Further legal action will be taken based on his statement and the findings of the investigation.

Authorities noted that similar incidents involving Indian tourists and transgender s*x workers have been reported in Pattaya in the past. In September, an Indian man was assaulted after allegedly touching a transgender woman inappropriately, while another incident in October involved two Indian nationals being attacked by transwomen following a dispute over service charges, with valuables reportedly stolen.

Police said investigations in the present case are ongoing.

articles.title: Retired IAF Officer Murdered by Own Sons for Property: Contract Killers, Including UP Cop, Hired
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ghaziabad police have made a sensational disclosure in the murder of a retired Indian Air Force (IAF) personnel in the Loni area, revealing that the crime was allegedly plotted by the victim’s own sons over a property dispute.

body.html:
Ghaziabad police have made a sensational disclosure in the murder of a retired Indian Air Force (IAF) personnel in the Loni area, revealing that the crime was allegedly plotted by the victim’s own sons over a property dispute.

The victim, Yogesh (58), a retired IAF employee and a native of Baghpat district, was shot dead on December 26 while returning to his home in Ashok Vihar Colony under the Loni police station limits. He was attacked by two bike-borne assailants, said Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP), Loni, Siddhartha Gautam.

Police investigations revealed that Yogesh was trying to get his house vacated by his sons, Nitish and Guddu, which allegedly led them to plan his murder out of greed for the property. The sons allegedly hired a neighbour, Arvind Kumar (32), as a contract killer for ₹5 lakh.

According to police, Arvind, along with his brother-in-law Naveen, a constable posted in Kaushambi district, carried out the shooting. “During interrogation, Arvind confessed that he and Naveen fired two shots at Yogesh, resulting in his death,” ACP Gautam said.

Arvind was arrested on Wednesday evening and produced before the Chief Judicial Magistrate’s court in Ghaziabad on Thursday, which remanded him to 14 days of judicial custody. Police recovered a .315 bore country-made pistol, two live cartridges and spent cartridges from his possession.

During questioning, Arvind claimed that Yogesh often abused family members while intoxicated and had frequent disputes with neighbours. He said the victim’s sons shared their grievances with him and later offered him a contract to kill their father. Police said the sons planned to withdraw money from Yogesh’s bank account after the murder to pay the contract amount.

The constable Naveen and the two sons of the deceased are currently absconding. Police teams have been formed to arrest them. Further investigation into the case is underway.

articles.title: New Year’s Eve Turns Brutal: Married Woman Attacks Lover at Mumbai Home, Police Launch Manhunt
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was reported from Mumbai where a 25-year-old married woman allegedly attacked her 44-year-old married lover with a knife at her residence on New Year’s Eve.

body.html:
A shocking incident was reported from Mumbai where a 25-year-old married woman allegedly attacked her 44-year-old married lover with a knife at her residence on New Year’s Eve. The incident occurred in the early hours of December 31, 2025, when the woman allegedly invited the man to her house on the pretext of offering New Year sweets.

According to police, the accused and the victim had been in a relationship for the past six to seven years. The woman had reportedly been pressuring the man to leave his wife and marry her, which led to frequent disputes between them. Disturbed by the situation, the victim had gone to Bihar in November 2025. Police said that during this period, the woman allegedly continued to threaten him over phone calls.

After returning to Mumbai on December 19, the victim reportedly distanced himself and avoided contact with the woman. However, on December 31 at around 1.30 am, she allegedly called him to her house while her children were asleep. Police said that during the meeting, the woman suddenly attacked him with a knife, causing serious injuries.

Despite excessive bleeding, the injured man managed to return home. His sons and friends immediately rushed him to VN Desai Hospital, from where he was referred to Sion Hospital for further treatment. Doctors said the injuries were severe and surgery may be required.

Police have revealed that the accused woman is the sister-in-law of the victim’s sister, adding a family link to the relationship. A case has been registered, and the woman fled the spot after the incident. She remains absconding, and police teams are conducting searches to trace her.

Further investigation into the matter is ongoing.

articles.title: Ghaziabad Man Accuses Policemen of Misconduct, Threatens March to CM’s Office
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Questions have once again been raised over police conduct in Ghaziabad following an incident reported from the night of December 21 in the Modinagar police station area. A local resident has alleged misconduct by two policemen on Niwari Road.

body.html:
Questions have once again been raised over police conduct in Ghaziabad following an incident reported from the night of December 21 in the Modinagar police station area. A local resident has alleged misconduct by two policemen on Niwari Road.

According to the complainant, two policemen were allegedly consuming alcohol inside a car along with a woman, which was parked outside his house. When he objected and asked them to remove the vehicle, he was allegedly abused by the policemen and the woman present with them.

The victim further alleged that after he recorded a video of the incident, he was pressured to delete it and threatened with being implicated in a false case. He has accused the police of attempting to suppress the matter and claimed that a fraudulent settlement was forced upon him.

The complainant has submitted a written complaint to the Police Commissioner and warned that if he does not get justice, he will walk to the Chief Minister’s office along with his family. A video related to the incident has also gone viral on social media, in which a woman is allegedly seen abusing.

Responding to the matter, Ghaziabad Police said that based on the written complaint received at Niwari police station, an FIR has been registered under relevant sections. The investigation is being carried out by Modinagar police station.

Police officials added that regarding the remaining allegations, the Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP), Modinagar, has been directed to conduct an inquiry into the matter. Further action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

articles.title: Live-in Couple Locked Inside Hut, Burnt Alive in Tamil Nadu Village; Police Probe Suspicious Dou
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has been reported from Pakkiripalayam village near Chengam in Tamil Nadu, where a couple in a live-in relationship were allegedly locked inside their hut and set on fire, leading to their deaths. The deceased have been identified as 53-year-old P.

body.html:
A shocking incident has been reported from Pakkiripalayam village near Chengam in Tamil Nadu, where a couple in a live-in relationship were allegedly locked inside their hut and set on fire, leading to their deaths. The deceased have been identified as 53-year-old P. Sakthivel, a farmer, and his partner S. Amrutham (40).

The incident came to light after police received information about a hut fire in the village. When the Chengam police reached the spot, they found the hut completely gutted and two bodies burnt beyond recognition inside. A forensic team and dog squad were immediately called to the scene, and postmortem examinations were conducted on-site, said Chengam Inspector M. Selvaraj.

Preliminary investigation revealed that both Sakthivel and Amrutham were married earlier but had been living separately from their respective spouses. Sakthivel had separated from his wife, S. Tamilarasi, three years ago. The couple has two sons and a daughter, who currently live with their mother in Bengaluru. Amrutham had also separated from her husband and has two sons and a daughter.

According to police, Sakthivel’s daughter had visited him on Thursday evening and had dinner with him before leaving around 9 pm. Later that night, neighbours living near the hut woke up after sensing a strong smell of burning and discovered that the hut was on fire. They immediately informed the police.

Inspector Selvaraj said the couple had been living together for the past three years in a small 10x10 feet hut built on a three-acre plot of land taken on lease from villagers. “We have registered a case of suspicious death and are investigating the incident from all angles. We are also examining whether the estranged partners of the deceased had any role in the crime,” he said.

Police said further investigation is underway to ascertain the exact sequence of events and identify those responsible.

articles.title: Outrage at Bada Imambara: Man Caught Urinating at Sacred Monument, FIR Filed After Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An incident of alleged desecration at Lucknow’s historically and religiously significant Bada Imambara has sparked widespread outrage after a video surfaced showing a man urinating at the site.

body.html:
An incident of alleged desecration at Lucknow’s historically and religiously significant Bada Imambara has sparked widespread outrage after a video surfaced showing a man urinating at the site. Taking the matter seriously, the Hussainabad Trust and its affiliated bodies have lodged an FIR against an unknown person at Chowk police station.

According to the complaint, a viral video shows a man urinating on the roof area of the Bada Imambara’s maze. Assistant Office Superintendent of the Trust, Habibul Hasan, filed the complaint, stating that the act was a clear violation of the sanctity and dignity of the religious monument.

Officials said the Bada Imambara holds immense religious and historical importance, and such an act has not only damaged its sanctity but also hurt the religious sentiments of the public. Based on the complaint, Chowk police have registered an FIR against an unidentified individual under Section 298 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), which relates to acts intended to wound religious feelings.

Chowk Kotwali police said an investigation is underway to identify the accused. CCTV footage from the premises and videos circulating on social media are being closely examined. Police officials stated that strict legal action will be taken once the accused is identified.

The Hussainabad Trust has also reiterated that firm steps will be taken to ensure the dignity and sanctity of religious and heritage sites are protected.

articles.title: Fake DSP Caught Roaming in Mau: Man in Senior Police Uniform Turns Out to Be an Impostor
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kotwali police in Mau have arrested a man who was roaming in public wearing the uniform of a DSP-rank police officer.

body.html:
Kotwali police in Mau have arrested a man who was roaming in public wearing the uniform of a DSP-rank police officer. The accused has been identified as 34-year-old Prabhat Pandey, a resident of Siddharthnagar, who was found moving suspiciously in the Munshipura area under the Kotwali police station limits.

Local residents grew suspicious after noticing the man dressed as a senior police officer without any government vehicle, escort, or official movement. They immediately alerted the police. Acting on the information, Kotwali police reached the spot and took the accused into custody.

City Police Inspector Anil Kumar Singh said that during interrogation, it was found that Prabhat Pandey had arrived in Mau from Varanasi on Friday. He had informed his family that he was travelling to Siddharthnagar, but instead reached Mau, where he began searching for an old friend. During this period, he was seen roaming the locality wearing a Circle Officer–level uniform.

Police investigation confirmed that Prabhat Pandey is not associated with the police department in any capacity. During questioning, the accused claimed that he is suffering from a serious illness and is mentally disturbed, which has affected his family life.

Kotwali police have registered a case against him for fraud and misuse of a police uniform. Further investigation into the matter is currently underway.

articles.title: ‘Save Me and My Children’: Meerut Influencer Row Turns Ugly as Husband Cries at Police Station
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A family dispute involving Meerut-based social media influencer Shadab Jakati and content creator Iram has triggered widespread controversy, following allegations made by Iram’s husband, Khurshid, also known as Sonu.

body.html:
A family dispute involving Meerut-based social media influencer Shadab Jakati and content creator Iram has triggered widespread controversy, following allegations made by Iram’s husband, Khurshid, also known as Sonu. The matter came to light after Khurshid lodged a complaint at Incholi police station, accusing Iram and Jakati of threatening to kill him.

Khurshid alleged that Iram frequently stays away from home for three to four days at a time to collaborate with Jakati, with whom she appears in videos portraying herself as his “on-screen wife.” He claimed that when he objected to this arrangement, both Iram and Jakati threatened him, leading to fears for his life and the safety of their children. The case gained attention after videos surfaced online showing Khurshid crying at the police station and pleading for protection.

In his complaint, Khurshid further claimed that Jakati had recently been embroiled in a separate controversy involving inappropriate videos linked to his minor daughter. He alleged a conspiracy to murder him and said he was under severe mental distress due to the situation.

Responding to the allegations, Iram released a video denying any extramarital relationship with Jakati. She stated that she works with him by choice as a content creator and earns money to support their four children. Iram accused Khurshid of physically assaulting her, claimed that he had given her triple talaq, and said she wanted separation. She dismissed the allegations of threats as false and baseless.

According to reports, the complaint was filed around January 1, 2026. The issue has since sparked intense debate on social media, with some users expressing sympathy for Khurshid, while others defended Iram’s right to work as a content creator. As of early January 2026, there has been no official confirmation of arrests or a resolution by the police.
